user.title: TV address
user.description: IP address or host name of the LG TV. A fixed address (DHCP reservation) is recommended.

confirmer_decouverte.title: TV discovered
confirmer_decouverte.description: Set up {name} ({host})? A pairing request will then appear on its screen.

reauth_confirm.title: New pairing required
reauth_confirm.description: The TV ({host}) no longer accepts the pairing key, for example after a software update. Stand in front of the screen, then submit: a pairing request will appear on it.

progress.appairage: Accept the pairing request shown on the TV screen ({host}). It expires after two minutes.

error.appairage_echoue: Pairing failed: request declined or expired, or TV unreachable (it must be on).

abort.cannot_connect: TV address missing from the network announcement.

init.title: Adaptive brightness
init.description: Sets the OLED pixel brightness from an ambient light sensor, on a logarithmic scale close to how the eye perceives light. The reading is smoothed, and a brief or isolated change is ignored. A brightness change made elsewhere (remote, Home Assistant, preset) pauses the feature. If the TV's Energy Saving or the Eco picture mode already adjusts brightness, the feature steps back and reports it in Repairs. Without a sensor, the feature is off.

data_description.capteur_lux: Leave empty to turn the feature off and remove its entities.
data_description.emplacement_capteur: Next to the screen, facing the room, is the best choice. Facing the screen (D), the screen lights the sensor: the feature waits longer after each change. Diagram and advice in the panel.
data_description.lux_min: Below this, the minimum brightness applies.
data_description.lux_max: Above this, the maximum brightness applies.
data_description.pause: The pause also ends the next time the TV is turned on, or with the Resume button.
data_description.modes_exclus: Modes where brightness is never changed (calibrated modes).

avance.name: Advanced settings
avance.description: Left empty, they follow the sensor profile (derived from its integration and how often it reports) and its location.

data_description.ecart_minimal: Brightness changes smaller than this are ignored.
data_description.lissage_montee_s: Smoothing time constant when light increases (0: no smoothing).
data_description.lissage_descente_s: Smoothing time constant when light decreases; slower than when brighter, so a passing shadow is not followed.
data_description.hysteresis_montee: Light increase, relative to the last application, that triggers a new calculation.
data_description.hysteresis_descente: Light decrease, relative to the last application, that triggers a new calculation.
data_description.confirmation_saut_s: A reading more than 4 times higher or lower waits this long, or for a second reading, before being used (0: no wait).
data_description.gel_ecriture_s: After each brightness change, readings are set aside for this long: the sensor may see the screen change.

error.lux_max_trop_bas: Must be above the dark room value.
error.luminosite_max_trop_basse: Must be at least the minimum brightness.

state.conflit_economie_energie: Conflicts with the TV's energy saving

ecriture_impossible.title: The TV refuses settings changes
ecriture_impossible.description: The TV no longer grants the integration any way to write settings, probably after a software update. Settings remain readable in real time but can no longer be changed from Home Assistant. Writing will come back by itself if a later software version allows it again.

conflit_economie_energie.title: The TV's energy saving conflicts with adaptive brightness
conflit_economie_energie.description: Energy Saving (General › Energy Saving) is not Off: the TV already adjusts the screen brightness itself (in Auto, from its own sensor). The two would fight each other: adaptive brightness writes nothing while this setting stays on. Fix sets it to Off.

confirm.title: Turn energy saving off
confirm.description: Energy Saving will be set to Off, and adaptive brightness will take over. The screen may use more power.

conflit_mode_eco.title: The Eco picture mode conflicts with adaptive brightness
conflit_mode_eco.description: In Eco mode, the TV's sensor adjusts the OLED pixel brightness itself from the ambient light. Adaptive brightness writes nothing in this mode. Choose another picture mode, or leave Eco alone in the feature's options.

capteur_fige.title: The light sensor no longer reports
capteur_fige.description: {capteur} has sent no reading since {depuis}, much longer than usual, while the TV is on. Flat battery, or device unreachable (Zigbee network, Wi-Fi)? Adaptive brightness keeps the current brightness until the next reading.

regler.name: Set
regler.description: Writes a TV setting, optionally only when a given picture mode is active (picture settings belong to the active mode only). The response gives the old and new value.

valeur.name: Value
valeur.description: Number for a slider, menu label (or API value) for a list, on/off for a switch.

mode_image.name: Only in picture mode
mode_image.description: Writes only when this picture mode is active; otherwise the action does nothing and says so in its response.

appliquer_preset.name: Apply a preset
appliquer_preset.description: Applies a saved preset: picture mode first, then the settings captured for that mode. The response lists applied and failed settings.

options.a: A — Next to the screen, facing the room (recommended)
options.b: B — Behind the TV, facing the wall
options.c: C — On the ceiling, facing down
options.d: D — At the sofa, facing the screen (not recommended)
options.e: E — At the sofa, facing up
options.f: F — Near a window (not recommended alone)
